title: Trust in the Name of the Lord

questions.question: May the Lord answer you in the day of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 20:1 (ESV): "May the Lord answer you in the day of trouble!"

questions.question: May the name of the God of whom protect you?
questions.explanation: Psalm 20:1 (ESV): "...the name of the God of Jacob protect you!"

questions.question: May he send you help from the sanctuary and give you support from where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 20:2 (ESV): "May he send you help from the sanctuary and give you support from Zion!"

questions.question: Some trust in chariots and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 20:7 (ESV): "Some trust in chariots and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the Lord our God."

questions.question: O Lord, save the king! May he answer us when we what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 20:9 (ESV): "O Lord, save the king! May he answer us when we call."

questions.question: May he remember all your offerings and regard with favor your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 20:3 (ESV): "May he remember all your offerings and regard with favor your burnt sacrifices!"

questions.question: May he grant you your heart's desire and fulfill all your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 20:4 (ESV): "May he grant you your heart's desire and fulfill all your plans!"

questions.question: May we shout for joy over your salvation and in the name of our God set up our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 20:5 (ESV): "May we shout for joy over your salvation and in the name of our God set up our banners!"

questions.question: Now I know that the Lord saves his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 20:6 (ESV): "Now I know that the Lord saves his anointed;"

questions.question: They collapse and fall, but we rise and stand how?
questions.explanation: Psalm 20:8 (ESV): "They collapse and fall, but we rise and stand upright."

questions.question: He will answer him from his holy heaven with the saving might of his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 20:6 (ESV): "...with the saving might of his right hand."

questions.question: What is the word used after "burnt sacrifices" suggesting a pause?
The Psalm is a prayer for whom before battle?
questions.explanation: Context of "save the king" and "his anointed".

questions.question: May the Lord fulfill all your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 20:5 (ESV): "May the Lord fulfill all your petitions!"

questions.question: Where does help come from in verse 2?
questions.explanation: Psalm 20:2 (ESV): "May he send you help from the sanctuary..."

key_verse_text: Some trust in chariots and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the Lord our God.
